name: Language & Literature Room
description: Text-led lessons: key vocabulary, how the text works, an idea to examine, discussion prompts, and a writing or speaking activity. For English, languages, arts and philosophy.
audience: Poems, passages, grammar points and writing skills.

signals.why: your words point to language or literature
this subject is language or arts based

slides.guidance: Lesson title for {topic} and a short subtitle that names the class level.
What students will be able to notice, explain or write after {topic}.
Words or terms for {topic} with a plain meaning and, where useful, a short example in context.
How the text or technique in {topic} works: three or four clear points tied to evidence in the text.
One detail or idea in {topic} worth noticing, with why it matters.

variants.guidance: A classroom meme about {topic}. Pick one format from MEME FORMATS that matches the idea, write captions a {grade} student finds funny and that make the correct idea easier to remember. Kind to students, never about a person.

slides.guidance: Open questions about {topic} that have more than one defensible answer.
A short writing or speaking task on {topic}, with minutes and grouping.
Key ideas and the one skill students practised.
